title: Eagles DC Vic Fangio: Number of snaps impacted defense against Rams, but have to finish

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles DC Vic Fangio: Number of snaps impacted defense against Rams, but have to finish
sources.description: The Eagles had a 20-10 lead over the Rams deep into the fourth quarter of last Sunday's game against the Rams, but they wound up losing when the Rams scored back-to-back touchdowns in the final four minutes of the game.
